label: UEFN Virtual Pointer
description: UEFN Virtual Pointer — cross-platform pointer via Verse Enhanced Input: TouchMapping + PointerSelect (publishable), PointerZoom (Experimental), swipes, taps, pinch, screen-space deproject/trace. Bundles the virtualpointer skill + 3 New-file Verse templates.

steps.title: Virtual Pointer skill ready
steps.body: Virtual Pointer recipes + Verse templates are installed. Ask the agent about TouchMapping, PointerSelect, swipes, pinch zoom, or screen-space world traces, or pick a VP template in New file → Verse.

verse.templates.name: VP Screen-space Trace
verse.templates.description: Virtual Pointer tap/click → DeprojectViewportToWorld → FindSweepHits. TouchMapping + PointerSelect (publishable).

verse.templates.name: VP Swipe Detector
verse.templates.description: Per-player swipe / tap classifier (Up/Down/Left/Right) from PointerSelect Begin → Trigger → End. Publishable.

verse.templates.name: VP Pinch Scale (Experimental)
verse.templates.description: PointerZoom pinch / scroll / right-stick → scale a Scene Graph entity. Experimental: cannot publish.

verse.templates.name: Virtual Pointer Pack
verse.templates.description: All three Virtual Pointer devices in Verse/VirtualPointer/: screen-space trace, swipe detector, pinch scale (Experimental).
